steps.why: The rate is set by whichever requirement is scarcest, so improving anything else changes nothing until that one is fixed.
common_mistakes: Saying the rate is set by the largest factor. It is set by the one in shortest supply.
Leaving out 'rate'. The law is about the RATE of the process.
steps.memory_tip: The scarcest ingredient sets the speed.
